source.time_semantics: MATLAB datenum converted to source CDT using ordinal + fraction - 366 days; UTC = CDT +05:00 for Jul-Aug 2016; date range independently matches accession

target: whether station DO percent saturation is <20% at +6h or +12h; loading-state target, not Jubilee-event target

validation.scheme: contiguous 3-day held-out time blocks; training excludes 12h buffer before and after each held-out block; pooled out-of-block predictions
validation.common_case_rows: all feature families evaluated on identical complete-case rows per horizon

models.hydrography: station + depth/salinity/temperature, 3h/6h changes, hour-of-day sin/cos; excludes current DO
models.combined: persistence plus hydrography plus 3h/6h DO changes

decision: Current low-oxygen state has strong persistence at 6h and useful persistence at 12h. Hydrography/trend features do not improve common-case Brier/log-loss/AUC over current DO and therefore fail the incremental feature-promotion gate in this dataset. This validates a reservoir/loading-state concept only; it does not validate shoreline transport/contact or Jubilee-event forecast skill.
limits: Only one short 2016 deployment and three stations.
DO is percent saturation; no mg/L hypoxia threshold is inferred.
Deployment geometry/official station aliases remain incompletely mapped.
No canonical 2016 Jubilee event labels are joined.
Out-of-block rows are serially correlated within episodes despite 3-day blocks and buffers; metrics are shadow research, not production qualification.
